**Dirac's lemma, strong form**: in a chordless-cycle-free adjacency structure, every
vertex set is a clique or contains two nonadjacent simplicial vertices.

nodes.doc:
**The assembled-cycle contradiction**: two length-minimal x-y connectors through
disjoint, mutually non-adjacent sides cannot coexist with chordless-cycle-freeness when
x and y are non-adjacent.

hypotheses.name: hABdisj
hypotheses.pretty: ∀ (v : ι), QA v → QB v → False

hypotheses.name: hABnadj
hypotheses.pretty: ∀ (u v : ι), QA u → QB v → ¬HiddenChannelCapacity.Adj 𝒞 u v

hypotheses.name: hvA
hypotheses.pretty: ∀ v ∈ pA, v = x ∨ v = y ∨ QA v

hypotheses.name: hminA
hypotheses.pretty:
∀ (q : List ι),
  (List.IsChain (HiddenChannelCapacity.Adj 𝒞) q ∧
      q.Nodup ∧ q.head? = some x ∧ q.getLast? = some y ∧ ∀ v ∈ q, v = x ∨ v = y ∨ QA v) →
    pA.length ≤ q.length

hypotheses.name: hvB
hypotheses.pretty: ∀ v ∈ pB, v = x ∨ v = y ∨ QB v

hypotheses.name: hminB
hypotheses.pretty:
∀ (q : List ι),
  (List.IsChain (HiddenChannelCapacity.Adj 𝒞) q ∧
      q.Nodup ∧ q.head? = some x ∧ q.getLast? = some y ∧ ∀ v ∈ q, v = x ∨ v = y ∨ QB v) →
    pB.length ≤ q.length

nodes.pretty:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] {𝒞 : Finset (Finset ι)},
  (¬∃ l, HiddenChannelCapacity.IsChordlessCycle 𝒞 l) →
    ∀ {QA QB : ι → Prop} {x y : ι},
      x ≠ y →
        ¬HiddenChannelCapacity.Adj 𝒞 x y →
          ¬QB x →
            ¬QB y →
              (∀ (v : ι), QA v → QB v → False) →
                (∀ (u v : ι), QA u → QB v → ¬HiddenChannelCapacity.Adj 𝒞 u v) →
                  ∀ (pA : List ι),
                    List.IsChain (HiddenChannelCapacity.Adj 𝒞) pA →
                      pA.Nodup →
                        pA.head? = some x →
                          pA.getLast? = some y →
                            (∀ v ∈ pA, v = x ∨ v = y ∨ QA v) →
                              (∀ (q : List ι),
                                  (List.IsChain (HiddenChannelCapacity.Adj 𝒞) q ∧
                                      q.Nodup ∧
                                        q.head? = some x ∧ q.getLast? = some y ∧ ∀ v ∈ q, v = x ∨ v = y ∨ QA v) →
                                    pA.length ≤ q.length) →
                                ∀ (pB : List ι),
                                  List.IsChain (HiddenChannelCapacity.Adj 𝒞) pB →
                                    pB.Nodup →
                                      pB.head? = some x →
                                        pB.getLast? = some y →
                                          (∀ v ∈ pB, v = x ∨ v = y ∨ QB v) →
                                            (∀ (q : List ι),
                                                (List.IsChain (HiddenChannelCapacity.Adj 𝒞) q ∧
                                                    q.Nodup ∧
                                                      q.head? = some x ∧
                                                        q.getLast? = some y ∧ ∀ v ∈ q, v = x ∨ v = y ∨ QB v) →
                                                  pB.length ≤ q.length) →
                                              False

nodes.doc:
**Minimality kills chords**: a length-minimal constrained x-y path has no adjacency
between positions at distance ≥ 2.

hypotheses.name: hvert
hypotheses.pretty: ∀ v ∈ p, v = x ∨ v = y ∨ Q v

hypotheses.name: hmin
hypotheses.pretty:
∀ (q : List ι),
  (List.IsChain (HiddenChannelCapacity.Adj 𝒞) q ∧
      q.Nodup ∧ q.head? = some x ∧ q.getLast? = some y ∧ ∀ v ∈ q, v = x ∨ v = y ∨ Q v) →
    p.length ≤ q.length

nodes.pretty:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {𝒞 : Finset (Finset ι)} {Q : ι → Prop} {x y : ι} {p : List ι},
  List.IsChain (HiddenChannelCapacity.Adj 𝒞) p →
    p.head? = some x →
      p.getLast? = some y →
        (∀ v ∈ p, v = x ∨ v = y ∨ Q v) →
          (∀ (q : List ι),
              (List.IsChain (HiddenChannelCapacity.Adj 𝒞) q ∧
                  q.Nodup ∧ q.head? = some x ∧ q.getLast? = some y ∧ ∀ v ∈ q, v = x ∨ v = y ∨ Q v) →
                p.length ≤ q.length) →
            p.Nodup →
              ∀ {i j : ℕ} (hi : i < p.length) (hj : j < p.length), i + 2 ≤ j → ¬HiddenChannelCapacity.Adj 𝒞 p[i] p[j]
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {p : List ι} {y : ι}, p.getLast? = some y → ∀ (h0 : 0 < p.length), p[p.length - 1] = y
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] (l : List ι), (HiddenChannelCapacity.cyclePairs l).length = l.length

nodes.doc: Every vertex on a walk is reachable from its head.
nodes.pretty:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {𝒞 : Finset (Finset ι)} {P : ι → Prop} {u v : ι} {p : List ι},
  HiddenChannelCapacity.IsWalkOn 𝒞 P p → p.head? = some u → v ∈ p → HiddenChannelCapacity.ReachOn 𝒞 P u v

∀ {ι : Type u_1} {𝒞 : Finset (Finset ι)} {P : ι → Prop} {u v w : ι},
  HiddenChannelCapacity.ReachOn 𝒞 P u v → HiddenChannelCapacity.Adj 𝒞 v w → P w → HiddenChannelCapacity.ReachOn 𝒞 P u w
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {Q : List ι → Prop}, (∃ p, Q p) → ∃ p, Q p ∧ ∀ (q : List ι), Q q → p.length ≤ q.length

nodes.doc:
A connector: an x-y path with interior inside `Q`, from adjacent entry points and
interior reachability.
nodes.pretty:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {𝒞 : Finset (Finset ι)} {Q : ι → Prop} {x y u₁ u₂ : ι},
  x ≠ y →
    HiddenChannelCapacity.Adj 𝒞 x u₁ →
      HiddenChannelCapacity.Adj 𝒞 y u₂ →
        HiddenChannelCapacity.ReachOn 𝒞 Q u₁ u₂ →
          ¬Q x →
            ¬Q y →
              ∃ p,
                List.IsChain (HiddenChannelCapacity.Adj 𝒞) p ∧
                  p.Nodup ∧ p.head? = some x ∧ p.getLast? = some y ∧ ∀ v ∈ p, v = x ∨ v = y ∨ Q v

nodes.doc:
If `x` has no neighbor reachable from `a` off the separator, then erasing `x` still
separates: the first `x`-occurrence on any violating path has its predecessor reachable
from `a` and adjacent to `x`.

hypotheses.name: hno
hypotheses.pretty: ∀ (u : ι), u ∈ S \ Sep ∧ HiddenChannelCapacity.ReachOn 𝒞 (fun v => v ∈ S \ Sep) a u → ¬HiddenChannelCapacity.Adj 𝒞 x u

hypotheses.name: hsep
hypotheses.pretty: ¬HiddenChannelCapacity.ReachOn 𝒞 (fun v => v ∈ S \ Sep) a b

nodes.pretty:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] {𝒞 : Finset (Finset ι)} {S Sep : Finset ι} {a b x : ι},
  x ≠ a →
    (∀ (u : ι),
        u ∈ S \ Sep ∧ HiddenChannelCapacity.ReachOn 𝒞 (fun v => v ∈ S \ Sep) a u → ¬HiddenChannelCapacity.Adj 𝒞 x u) →
      ¬HiddenChannelCapacity.ReachOn 𝒞 (fun v => v ∈ S \ Sep) a b →
        ¬HiddenChannelCapacity.ReachOn 𝒞 (fun v => v ∈ S \ Sep.erase x) a b

nodes.doc: Every chained walk contains a duplicate-free path with the same endpoints and vertices.
nodes.pretty:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {𝒞 : Finset (Finset ι)} {P : ι → Prop} (p : List ι),
  HiddenChannelCapacity.IsWalkOn 𝒞 P p →
    ∀ {u v : ι}, p.head? = some u → p.getLast? = some v → HiddenChannelCapacity.ReachOn 𝒞 P u v
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : ι → ι → Prop} {p : List ι}, List.IsChain R p → ∀ (n : ℕ), List.IsChain R (List.drop n p)
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : ι → ι → Prop} {p : List ι}, List.IsChain R p → ∀ (n : ℕ), List.IsChain R (List.take n p)
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {p : List ι} {x : ι}, p.head? = some x → ∀ (h0 : 0 < p.length), p[0] = x
∀ {ι : Type u_1} (l : List ι) {s t : ℕ} (hs : s < l.length) (ht : t < l.length), s = t → l[s] = l[t]
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {𝒞 : Finset (Finset ι)} {u v : ι}, HiddenChannelCapacity.Adj 𝒞 u v → HiddenChannelCapacity.Adj 𝒞 v u
